name: Hailo-8 Datasheet Rev 1.9.2 (Hailo, April 2026)
notes: Datasheet confirms a fully integrated memory architecture with no external DRAM interface. The only numeric memory in the datasheet is 640 KB SRAM for the dual Cortex-M4 MCU (plus 128 KB ROM); NN-core SRAM capacity and bandwidth are not published, so both are null rather than estimated.
